events.text: Ding! The voice in your head wakes you in the middle of the night, very pleased with itself. "Rare host privileges unlocked. The System Shop now stocks artefacts: treasures that stay with you, unlike pills, which you keep eating." A blue window hangs over your bed with three of them in it, and prices you cannot afford yet.

effects.log: "Rare hosts are not chosen," it says. "They are lucky. Do not let it go to your head." It sounds like it has said this before, to someone it liked.
"Do things," it says. "Rare hosts are paid a quarter more for doing them." That is the most useful thing anyone has told you all year.

events.text: Ding. Ding. Ding. The voice in your head has never sounded like this before: careful, almost respectful. "Mythic host," it says. "I have bound myself to eleven hosts in ten thousand years. You are the first Mythic. The shop is open to you, all of it. There is one thing in it nobody else can buy." Golden windows open in the air around you, too many to read.

choices.text: Ask what the one thing is

effects.log: "A body," it says. "The one from before heaven and earth. Nobody is born with it. It costs more than most hosts earn in a life." You decide on the spot to be most hosts.

choices.text: Ask what happened to the other eleven hosts

effects.log: A long silence. "Most of them did very well," it says at last. You notice the word most.

events.text: Ding! Hidden quest. "Mythic host. Somewhere in the world below there is an artefact I cannot sell you, because it was never made: it was found. Find one artefact the world hides, and it is yours to keep."

effects.log: Ding! Hidden quest accepted. No reward, no timer: whatever you find is yours. The voice hums to itself for the rest of the day. You did not know it could hum.

choices.text: Ask why a System needs you to find things

effects.log: "Because I am a voice," it says, "and you have hands." Fair.
